test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Swastik purchased a laptop for Rs. 75,000 and sold it to Anju suffering a loss of 10%. Anju sold the same laptop after earning a profit of 20%. At what price (in Rs.) did Anju sell the laptop?
solution:
**Given:**

Swastik purchased a laptop for Rs. 75,000 and sold it to Anju suffering a loss of 10%.

Anju sold the same laptop after earning a profit of 20%.

**Formula used:**

P = S.P - C.P

L = C.P - S.P

P = Profit

L = loss

S.P = Selling Price

C.P = Cost Price

**Calculation:**

The Cost Price of Swastik = Rs. 75,000

Swastik suffered a loss of 10%

⇒ S.P = C.P - L

⇒C.P of Anju = S.P of Swastik

⇒ 90% of 75,000

⇒ 67,500

Profit of Anju = 20%

⇒S.P = C.P + P

⇒S.P of Anju = 120% of 67,500

⇒ 81,000

**∴ Anju sells the laptop for **Rs.** 81,000.**
